db_schema.note: provenance_tier is String(30) NOT NULL with no DB CHECK enum; allowed values enforced in Pydantic + planning service.

authoritative.meaning: Authority-class / source-of-truth material for factory provenance — trusted textbook grounding, NOT a claim of official NTA endorsement or that TALOS content is 'official NCERT'.
evidence: content_factory_planning.py: PROVENANCE_TIERS = SOURCE_TIERS; rejects official claims
test_ncert_canonical_source.test_blueprint_with_canonical_source_accepts uses provenance_tier='authoritative' + ncert_source_path under NCERT Books
blueprint_declares_ncert_source: tier=='authoritative' implies NCERT binding required
authoritative.why_appropriate_for_canonical_ncert: Existing CF-SOURCE-001 tests and factory guards already bind authoritative + ncert_source_path to NCERT_SOURCE_ROOT. No schema change required to represent canonical NCERT PDFs.

licensed.meaning: Licensed third-party corpus (not the default NCERT Books path).

ai.meaning: AI-assisted generation contract; does not by itself require NCERT PDF binding.

derived.meaning: Derived from other content without claiming primary textbook authority.

explicitly_not_allowed.reason: 'ncert' is not in PROVENANCE_TIERS (Pydantic rejects). official/nta/ncert_official rejected as false official claims. Product rule: never invent official NTA/NCERT labels on content.

canonical_ncert_representation.summary: Canonical NCERT is already representable without schema change: provenance_tier='authoritative' plus constraints binding a PDF under D:\ravishori\AI Neet Exam App\NCERT Books.
canonical_ncert_representation.why_not_ncert_tier: Adding 'ncert' would (1) invent a non-enum value already rejected by Pydantic, (2) risk false official-claim confusion already blocked for official/nta/ncert_official, and (3) diverge from CF-SOURCE-001 tests that already use authoritative.

canonical_ncert_pdf_path.where: question_blueprints.constraints JSONB keys: ncert_source_path, canonical_ncert_pdf, source_pdf_path

source_document_identity.note: No blueprint.source_document_id column. Identity is path string in constraints; ingestion.source_documents exists for KU/ingestion lineage, not blueprint FK.

section.note: No first-class blueprint section field; KU may link ingestion_sections.

page_or_section_evidence.supported_on_questions: ncert_evidence body/tags on ContentItem (ECAEP certification path)
page_or_section_evidence.note: Blueprint constraints may store free-form keys but factory REQUIRED_CONSTRAINT_KEYS only mandate question_format/correct_option_count/explanation_required.

ncert_verification_state.note: ECAEP certify-ncert / ncert_evidence.verification_level — orthogonal to blueprint tier.

provenance_tier.canonical_ncert_representation: authoritative + constraints path under NCERT Books
